title: A sprint plan checks shared code by its behaviour, not its shape
goal: the sprint plan step of the kb-sprint skill tells the planner to give stories that change the same function checks on its behaviour, not on its internal shape, so a later story does not break an earlier done story's check

run:
import re, sys
s = open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
i, j = s.find('## plan'), s.find('## start')
sys.exit(0 if re.search(r'(?i)behaviou?r, not (?:its |their )?(?:internal )?shape', s[i:j]) else 1)

notes: Retrospective of SP-rmp5zm5a (2026-10-22, operator accepted): landing ST-o367qbqn broke ST-bbxlwm4b's check (asserted curl for an .html url), and landing ST-aml4xyrf broke ST-o367qbqn's (planted one argv per source); a done item's checks change only after a reopen.
